facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 Enterprise—Industry Leaders category requires a minimum revenue of $10 million in 2020.
facts.quote: This category is open to companies that recorded a minimum revenue of $10 million in 2020 and $50 million in 2023.

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 Enterprise—Industry Leaders award ranks companies by revenue growth percentage over their last four years of operation.
facts.quote: The award recognizes the fastest-growing enterprise-level technology, media, and telecommunications companies by revenue growth percentage over their last four years of operation.

facts.fact: StackAdapt was named an Enterprise—Industry Leaders award winner in the 2024 Technology Fast 50 program, announced November 6, 2024.
facts.quote: StackAdapt ([www.stackadapt.com](https://www.stackadapt.com/)), a leading multi-channel advertising platform, was honoured as an Enterprise—Industry Leaders award winner as part of the 2024 Technology Fast 50™ program.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2 (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2, and is the highest-performing and easiest-to-use platform.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 program recognizes growth in four categories: Technology Fast 50, Enterprise—Industry Leaders, Clean Technology, and Companies-to-Watch.
facts.quote: It recognizes business growth, innovation, and entrepreneurship in four distinct categories: Technology Fast 50, Enterprise—Industry Leaders, Clean Technology, and Companies-to-Watch.

facts.fact: Program sponsors for the 2024 Technology Fast 50 program were RBCx, Osler, EDC, CCI, TMX, Clarity, and Lafond.
facts.quote: Program sponsors for 2024 include RBCx, Osler, EDC, CCI, TMX, Clarity, and Lafond.
